# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.

completion:

Values`, enter the actual measured average for each performance specification (e.g. if testing `Color`, enter the measured value for `X`, `Y`, `Z`, `DQN` and/or `E` for each **Average Value for the specifications**). Make sure to test each attribute listed in the specification.
![test record example](avg-values.png)
